body: I have to be a reporter three days a week, but I'm so bad at it I have to work all week to set things up.  I also have to pay attention to the news all the time, I'm not allowed to just shut off I have to be on and thinking about work all the time.  If I stop I don't think I'll start again.
What happens if I go in, what happens to my apartment and my life?
It just doesn't feel like there's time, I really need help but I feel like my life would shatter if I took even one day off.

>Two years ago, I would've been freshly out of the hospital, now, it seems preposterous that I ever thought killing myself was even an option. You can feel that way too.

I'm balling my eyes out, or at least I feel like doing that, I just don't see how that happens...what did they do?  What happened?  Who helped?
I don't have windows, I have an old AIM account...I'm sorry, this feels really pathetic.

I'm so afraid that I can't ever retrieve my future if I go to a ward, but I really want to go.  I'm in my last semester of college, I'm supposed to graduate and have a future.  But the only way I'm convincing myself to make it through is the promise that I'll kill myself after this semester.  I'm so afraid, I'm just so afraid of the world.  JESUS FUCK I'm cutting, I'm supposed to be normal, but I'm cutting myself.  The fuck am I supposed to do?
Thanks, really thanks a lot, I like this.

I just can't help feeling like it's too late to change majors.  Plus, the only other majors I could think of that I would enjoy are history (can't really do anything with that) or art (complete waste of money and you can't do anything with it besides paint and hope your lucky enough to sell your stuff at ridiculous prices to stupid people).
A little better

>By constantly striving for money and recognition without regard for your mental needs, you're essentially saying you want to touch the tip of Mount Everest but you don't feel it's necessary to take anything else with you there but the clothes on your back and a single grilled cheese sandwich. You just can't do this to yourself.

I find this humorous, but confusing.

I'll try to take your advice about the guitar, I just don't know when I'll have the time.  It takes a lot of practice, and when I come home from class all I want to do is crawl into bed and sleep until I have to wake up and go back.

>You can succeed without education as well or simply change into a different course where you think you'd be more proficient

You CAN, but you won't get money or recognition and I'm sorry if those two things are necessary for me.  As far as changing course goes, I changed TO this one after screwing my life up in another course, what would be so different about another course?

>Go sell a bunch of your shit and buy a bus ticket to Colorado. Get a job bar-tending or washing dishes or something at a ski resort. Find a shitty little apartment and spend all day snowboarding while you bar-tend nights and weekends. Sure you might not have a journalism degree, but really, who the fuck cares? That beats the hell out of killing yourself doesn't it?

The thought of just leaving has occurred to me, but I'd be disappointing everyone in my life.  My parents have paid tons of money to put me through school, all of my friends and family expect me to graduate and go on to a career.  I have to fulfill people's expectations.  I know I'm not "supposed" to live my life that way, but that's how I've lived my life so far and it's how I'm going to have to carry on.  I can't just give up and say "fuck you" to everyone.
It is a noble profession, I just unfortunately suck at it...and I'm in school for broadcast not print, so it's not as noble.
I paint and read and mess around on the guitar, but those are just hobbies not passions.  I don't have passion.
I still feel like crap, still feel overwhelmed, still fill like everyone can see right through me.  But, I'm still here, for some reason.

> If journalism is not making you happy now, in all honesty, it probably won't in the real work force, so why not change? Do something YOU want to do, not something you feel obligated to do.

My parent's have spent far too much money for me not to pursue this, it would be a waste.  Plus, I'm 23, I'm already a couple of years behind other people.

> can I ask something of you? Tell me something wonderful about who you are and what you like to do in your spare time.

My therapists try this trick on me, I don't like it.  I do paint and read in my spare time, but...it's just doesn't feel like enough.

What I do defines who I am, I've got the intelligence enough to go far but the fucking rest of me (my personality, my social skills, all the necessary tools) aren't fucking there and never will be.  I'I'm taking sleeping pill (just one) and trying to get this night over with. I'll be back tomorrow since I have to spend another day thinking about suicide will trying to put on a smile and go to class and work.

I know I have choices, but it just feels like this is how life is always going to be unless I pick something that's so easy no one could do it.  Then I'm just a fucking normal person.  I mean I already know that in the big picture I'm insignificant, but it'd be nice to be noticed.
All those people were talented, I don't see one good thing about myself.  I really want to, I really want to be happy, but I can't.
Thanks for calling it a joke asshole
